name: Tududi
tagline: tududi is a task and project management web application built with Sinatra
description: tududi is a task and project management web application built with Sinatra. It allows users to efficiently manage their tasks and projects, categorize them into different areas, and track due dates. tududi is designed to be intuitive and easy to use, providing a seamless experience for personal productivity.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Tududi user password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Tududi session secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-tududi application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-tududi
  # The `big-bear-tududi` service definition
  big-bear-tududi:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-tududi
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: chrisvel/tududi:0.87@sha256:733bceb71e60ba73d75e33d66569edaf8be55b5cd113830ecaee11b48e8e392a
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - TUDUDI_USER_EMAIL=admin@example.com
      - TUDUDI_USER_PASSWORD=${SECRET_TUDUDI_USER_PASSWORD}
      - TUDUDI_SESSION_SECRET=${SECRET_TUDUDI_SESSION_SECRET}
      - TUDUDI_INTERNAL_SSL_ENABLED=false
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the tududi database directory
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/tududi/db:/usr/src/app/tududi_db
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 9292 of the host to port 9292 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:9292"
